promptText: Which soft brand or collection brands should an owner consider when affiliation flexibility is a priority for a hotel conversion in the Caribbean and Latin America?

payload.rawResponseText:
Here is a comprehensive breakdown of the **soft brands and collection brands** that hotel owners in the **Caribbean and Latin America (CALA)** should seriously consider when **affiliation flexibility** is the top priority for a conversion:

---

## 🏨 Soft Brands & Collections for Hotel Conversions in Caribbean & Latin America

### Why Soft Brands Make Sense for CALA Conversions


Soft brand hotels — also known as soft brand collections or collections of independent hotels — are a relatively recent trend in the hospitality industry. They provide a distinctive blend of autonomy and brand affiliation.
 This is precisely why they are so attractive for conversions in a region rich in independent, character-driven properties.


The flexibility soft brands offer to developers is a major draw. Soft-brand collections are more flexible in design, and many are conversions or adaptive-reuse projects, which makes them unique.



Conversions accounted for 32 percent of total room signings in 2024 in the CALA region, with 36 properties representing nearly 2,600 rooms in the conversion pipeline.


---

### 🔵 MARRIOTT INTERNATIONAL — Multiple Soft/Collection Options

Marriott is the most active player in CALA conversions and offers the broadest menu of collection brands across segments:


Marriott offers a unique value proposition for owners and franchisees with a robust portfolio of soft brands and conversion-friendly brands in the region. Conversions represented 32% of total room signings in the Caribbean and Latin America, including brands like **Autograph Collection Hotels**, **The Luxury Collection**, and **Tribute Portfolio**.


- **Autograph Collection** – 
Marriott played a pivotal role in expanding the soft brand hotel concept through its Autograph Collection, launched in 2010.
 Ideal for distinctive, independent-minded upscale and upper-upscale hotels that want to retain their identity.

- **The Luxury Collection** – 
A proven brand in CALA, as seen with the Sanctuary Cap Cana in the Dominican Republic — the first All-Inclusive Marriott hotel in the luxury segment.


- **Tribute Portfolio** – A more accessible entry point in the upscale soft-brand tier, also conversion-friendly.


For independent hoteliers, adding an existing property to Marriott's portfolio provides access to its well-established loyalty, distribution, and marketing platforms, global sales organization, and direct bookings at a low customer acquisition cost. Owners also have the opportunity for potential cost savings connecting to the Marriott ecosystem, which can aid in improving a property's visibility and positioning it for potentially higher occupancy.


---

### 🟡 HILTON — Curio Collection & Tapestry Collection


Hilton sees significant possibilities for Latin American properties to convert to one of the company's two soft brands.


- **Curio Collection by Hilton** – 
Hilton launched Curio Collection in 2014, creating a collection of independent, upscale hotels. Hilton's loyalty program — more than 226 million members strong — plays a pivotal role in convincing hotel owners to place their property under Curio's umbrella.


- **Tapestry Collection by Hilton** – 
With Curio Collection and Tapestry Collection soft brands in its stable, Hilton has a greater opportunity to "go to the owners who have assets that may well have a good identity but are just underperforming the market."



Along with using its conversion-oriented brands that are more nimble and agile, such as **Curio Collection** or **Tapestry Collection**, Hilton is also finding success with some of its brands in higher segments, such as DoubleTree by Hilton. Hilton is seeing a lot of repeat owners, which proves they are achieving the right type of growth in the region.


---

### 🔴 IHG HOTELS & RESORTS — Vignette Collection & voco


IHG provides a range of choices, and its soft-brand and conversion-friendly brands have helped to drive significant growth in the CALA region.


- **Vignette Collection** – 
Vignette Collection welcomes independent luxury and lifestyle hotels seeking distinct style and character while benefiting from IHG's global enterprise. Within a few years of its 2021 launch, the brand is already on pace to nearly triple its global estate.
 
IHG signed two Vignette Collection properties in CALA in one recent year and opened one in Peru, with another opening in the Dominican Republic.


- **voco Hotels** – 
The voco brand brings the recognition that many owners want without having to create a new identity for the hotel.
 
voco has already reached 225 open and pipeline hotels across more than 30 countries since its 2018 launch.


- **Garner** – 
IHG already has three collection and conversion brands: Vignette Collection, voco, and Garner
 — with Garner targeting the midscale conversion segment.


In the first quarter of 2025 alone, conversions accounted for around 60 percent of global openings and 40 percent of global signings for IHG.


---

### 🟢 HYATT — The Unbound Collection & Unscripted by Hyatt

- **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt** – 
The Unbound Collection by Hyatt is actively adding Americas properties, marking 10 years of growth in independent luxury hotels.
 It targets storied, one-of-a-kind properties.

- **Unscripted by Hyatt** *(newly launched, 2025)* – 
Positioned in the upscale segment, Unscripted by Hyatt is designed to unlock growth through adaptive reuse and conversion-friendly opportunities. With over 40 hotels globally in active discussions, it offers independent properties a light-touch operating model and flexible brand standards — empowering owners to maintain their unique identity while benefiting from Hyatt's global scale.



Hyatt is often viewed as more "owner-friendly" and less bureaucratic than Marriott
, which is an important consideration when affiliation flexibility is a priority.

---

### ⚪ CHOICE HOTELS — Ascend Hotel Collection


Choice Hotels offers the **Ascend Hotel Collection**
 as a soft brand option — particularly well-suited for independent midscale or upper-midscale properties. It is one of the earliest and most widely distributed soft-brand collections globally, with low conversion barriers.

---

### 🟤 INDEPENDENT CONSORTIUMS — For Maximum Flexibility

For owners who want the **least restrictive** affiliation of all (no hard franchise standards, no PIP mandates), voluntary/independent consortiums are worth considering:

- **Preferred Hotels & Resorts** – 
Considered the most flexible option, Preferred Hotels & Resorts offers five distinct collections to fit different asset classes and provides excellent sales support for MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions).


- **Leading Hotels of the World (LHW)** – 
LHW offers the highest prestige and is best for "trophy assets" where rate integrity is paramount. Its Leaders Club loyalty programme is now free to join, expanding its reach.


- **Small Luxury Hotels of the World (SLH)** – 
Under the Hilton–SLH hybrid partnership model, boutique hotels appear on Hilton's booking channels and offer loyalty points, but remain legally contracted to SLH — not Hilton.
 This offers global distribution without the full franchise commitment.

---

## 📊 Quick Comparison Summary

| Brand/Collection | Parent Company | Segment | Flexibility Level | CALA Activity |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Autograph Collection | Marriott | Upscale–Upper Upscale | High | Very Active |
| The Luxury Collection | Marriott | Luxury | High | Very Active |
| Tribute Portfolio | Marriott | Upscale | High | Active |
| Curio Collection | Hilton | Upscale | High | Active |
| Tapestry Collection | Hilton | Upscale | High | Active |
| Vignette Collection | IHG | Luxury & Lifestyle | High | Growing |
| voco Hotels | IHG | Premium | Medium-High | Growing |
| Unbound Collection | Hyatt | Luxury | High | Active |
| Unscripted by Hyatt | Hyatt | Upscale | Very High | Launching |
| Ascend Collection | Choice Hotels | Midscale–Upscale | High | Moderate |
| Preferred Hotels & Resorts | Independent | All Segments | Very High | Active |
| SLH / Hilton Partnership | Hybrid | Boutique Luxury | Very High | Active |

---

## Key Takeaway

For CALA owners prioritizing **flexibility**, the sweet spot lies in **Marriott's Autograph Collection or Tribute Portfolio**, **Hilton's Curio or Tapestry Collection**, **IHG's Vignette Collection or voco**, and **Hyatt's Unbound or new Unscripted brand** — all of which permit properties to retain their identity while tapping into powerful loyalty programs and distribution engines. For owners who want to minimize brand control entirely, **Preferred Hotels & Resorts** or the **SLH/Hilton hybrid model** offer the greatest autonomy.
